verdict.rationale: Unleash documents an Admin API for full programmatic flag management (unleash-docs-6), an official MCP server enabling LLM agents to create/manage flags (unleash-docs-7, unleash-probe-2), and Change Requests that require approval before changes take effect in an environment (unleash-docs-11), backed by RBAC (unleash-docs-12). This directly matches the story's core ask: agent-driven flag changes gated by human approval workflows. Missing for 10: no explicit CLI tool evidenced, and no direct documentation confirming change requests specifically intercept API/MCP-originated writes (only that they gate 'changes in an environment' generally) or independent/hands-on confirmation of this enforcement.
